findings.title: Expulsion warning text colour is still hard-coded to white.
findings.body: Every other warning rule now takes its colours from theme variables, but this one still sets the text to `#fff` while its background comes from `var(--warn-3-bg)`. If a theme sets a light `--warn-3-bg`, the white text becomes unreadable, and themes can't fix it. PLT input already uses `var(--warn-fg)` for the same warning. To fix, add a variable such as `--warn-3-fg: #fff` in common.css and use it here. The suggestion below uses `var(--warn-3-fg, #fff)`, which needs no other change and keeps the current look.
